Sample.evidence_source: as the 10 young men included in this study represented all the young men (no exclusion) between the age of 18 and 30 in the PA study (Dieserud, 2006)

Population.evidence_source: identifying idiographic warning signs of suicides among young men in the social transition to adulthood. Unlike most previous PA studies aimed at recognizing and/or identifying markers of a suicidal crisis (Hendin et al., 2004, 2001; Hendin, Maltsberger & Szanto, 2007; Maltsberger et al., 2003; Owens et al., 2011), this study used in-depth interviews with 4 –8 closely connected individuals per suicide, as well as suicide notes; it appears to be the first study that has identified warning signs of suicide from the perspective of many close informants, and systematically analysed this in terms of their relationship with the deceased.

Type.evidence_source: this study used in-depth interviews with 4 –8 closely connected individuals per suicide, as well as suicide notes

Area.evidence_source: This study shows that PA (Shneidman, 1993) is a suitable method of identifying idiographic warning signs of suicides among young men in the social transition to adulthood. Unlike most previous PA studies aimed at recognizing and/or identifying markers of a suicidal crisis
